description:
crate-jmap-types/src/wire.rs:10 declares `pub type Invocation = (String, serde_json::Value, String)`.

Once shipped at 0.1.1, this 3-tuple shape is locked into the public API
for the entire `jmap-*` family. Two concrete cost paths for callers:

1. **Positional access locks the contract.** Every consumer (kith, stoa,
   the 7+ extension crates, third-party JMAP clients) writes
   `inv.0`, `inv.1`, `inv.2` to pull out method name, arguments, and
   call id. There is no rustdoc-hover assistance: the field positions
   are documented in prose on the alias but not on the values. Once
   downstream code ships, the maintainer cannot replace `Invocation`
   with a struct with named fields without a major-version break.

2. **`serde_json::Value` in the middle slot pins the crate's public API
   to serde_json's major version forever.** If serde_json 2.x ever ships
   with a renamed/reshaped `Value`, `Invocation` breaks transitively for
   every consumer. The contract committed in 0.1.1 is implicitly:
   \"`jmap-types` ^0.1 requires serde_json ^1\". A reasonable mitigation
   would be a newtype like `pub struct Invocation { name, args, call_id }`
   where `args` is `serde_json::Value` for now but could be wrapped or
   typed in a future minor without changing the outer shape.

A caller depending on this API in production accepts: (a) `inv.N`
positional access for the lifetime of `jmap-types ^0.1`; (b) recompile
when serde_json's major version moves; (c) no rustdoc-hover help on what
position 1 vs 2 means.

Fix candidates (any of which is a breaking change requiring a major
bump and so is the wrong way around — file now while still 0.x):
- Convert to `pub struct Invocation { pub name: String, pub args:
  serde_json::Value, pub call_id: String }` with `#[serde(into = "..."`
  / `from = "..."` to keep the 3-element-array wire form.
- Or accept the lock and add `Invocation::name()`, `args()`,
  `call_id()` accessor methods so callers can opt out of positional
  access (and `inv.0`-using callers stay buildable forever).
title: Invocation 3-tuple type alias locks API shape and pins to serde_json major version
